components.name: Toolbar Chip
components.description: Filters / Sort style 36px chip; white-filled when filters are in use.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:36px; padding:0 16px; font-family: var(--font-ui, Hanken Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; color: var(--text, #f1f1f1); background-color: var(--surface-2, #292929); border:none; border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-chip:hover { background-color: var(--surface-3, #414141); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #3ea6ff); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-chip.is-active { color: var(--bg, #121212); background-color: var(--text, #f1f1f1); } .ds-chip.is-active:hover { background-color:#fff; } .ds-chip-count { display:inline-flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; min-width:18px; height:18px; padding:0 5px; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; color: var(--text, #f1f1f1); background-color: var(--bg, #121212); border-radius:999px; }

components.name: Go Button
components.description: Green fill for go actions only: Show, Save, Add Photos.
components.css: .ds-btn-go { padding:6px 14px; font-family: var(--font-ui, Hanken Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size:14px; font-weight:700; color: var(--on-green, #121212); background-color: var(--green, #3ecf8e); border:none; border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-go:hover { background-color: var(--green-2, #6bdba8); } .ds-btn-go:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #3ea6ff); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Quiet partner to a filled button, e.g. Clear All in the Filters footer.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { padding:6px 14px; font-family: var(--font-ui, Hanken Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size:14px; font-weight:700; color: var(--text, #f1f1f1); background:none; border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #4d4d4d); border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { color:#fff; border-color: var(--text, #f1f1f1); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #3ea6ff); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity:0.4; cursor:default; }

components.name: Search Field
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="7"/><path d="M21 21l-6-6"/></svg><input placeholder="Search monkeys" /></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; width:320px; height:40px; padding:0 14px; background-color: var(--field, #151515); border:1px solid var(--line, #323232); border-radius:999px; color: var(--text, #f1f1f1); transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-search:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, #4d4d4d); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent, #3ea6ff); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--accent, #3ea6ff); } .ds-search input { flex:1; height:100%; font-family: var(--font-ui, Hanken Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size:16px; color: var(--text, #f1f1f1); background:none; border:none; outline:none; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--text-3, #8c8c8c); }

components.name: Monkey Card
components.description: 5:4 photo with the name on a dark fade, one optional badge, then troop · sex · age in grey.
components.css: .ds-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; width:240px; padding:0; border:none; background:none; color:inherit; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; font-family: var(--font-ui, Hanken Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-card-photo { position:relative; display:block; aspect-ratio:5/4; overflow:hidden; border-radius:12px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5a5143, #2f2a22); transition: filter 0.2s; } .ds-card-photo::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset:40% 0 0; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.85)); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-photo { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline:none; } .ds-card:focus-visible .ds-card-photo { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #3ea6ff); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-card-name { position:absolute; left:10px; right:10px; bottom:8px; z-index:1; font-family: var(--font-display, 'Bitter', sans-serif); font-size:17px; line-height:1.15; color:#fff; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; } .ds-card-badge { position:absolute; left:6px; top:6px; z-index:1; padding:2px 7px; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; line-height:18px; color: var(--bg, #121212); background-color:#ff7a1a; border-radius:4px; } .ds-card-meta { display:flex; margin-top:6px; padding:0 2px; font-size:14px; line-height:1.3; color: var(--text-2, #aaaaaa); white-space:nowrap; } .ds-card-meta > span + span::before { content:'\00B7'; margin:0 6px; }

components.name: Side Rail Item
components.description: 40px rail row: icon then label; current page bold white on Chip Graphite.
components.html: MonkeysEnclosures
components.css: .ds-rail { display:flex; flex-direction:column; width:220px; padding:6px 4px; background-color: var(--surface-1, #1e1e1e); font-family: var(--font-ui, Hanken Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-rail-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; height:40px; margin-bottom:2px; padding:0 14px; font-size:14px; color: var(--text, #f1f1f1); text-decoration:none; border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-rail-item:hover { color:#fff; background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #3ea6ff); outline-offset:-2px; } .ds-rail-item[aria-current='page'] { font-weight:700; color:#fff; background-color: var(--surface-2, #292929); }

components.name: Sort Menu
components.description: Drop-down list with the direction faded beside each name.
components.css: .ds-menu { display:flex; flex-direction:column; min-width:180px; padding:4px; background-color: var(--surface-2, #292929); border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #4d4d4d); border-radius:10px; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-menu button { display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:8px; padding:9px 12px; font-family: var(--font-ui, Hanken Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size:15px; text-align:left; color: var(--text, #f1f1f1); background:none; border:none; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-menu button span { font-size:13px; color: var(--text-3, #8c8c8c); } .ds-menu button:hover, .ds-menu button:focus-visible { color:#fff; background-color: var(--line, #323232); outline:none; }

components.name: Add Photos Circle
components.description: Staff bottom-bar centre: 48px green circle with a soft glow.
components.html: <button class="ds-photos" aria-label="Add Photos"><svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 7h1a2 2 0 0 0 2-2 1 1 0 0 1 1-1h6a1 1 0 0 1 1 1 2 2 0 0 0 2 2h1a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v9a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V9a2 2 0 0 1 2-2"/><circle cx="12" cy="13" r="3"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-photos { display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; width:48px; height:48px; color: var(--on-green, #121212); background-color: var(--green, #3ecf8e); border:none; border-radius:50%; box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(62,207,142,0.25), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); cursor:pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-photos:hover { background-color: var(--green-2, #6bdba8); } .ds-photos:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-photos:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #3ea6ff); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
vervetDB is the category standard played straight: a first-class dark media app at YouTube and Supabase-dashboard craft, where the "videos" are monkeys. Faces lead. A near-black page carries a grid of rounded 5:4 photos with each monkey's name set on its own photo in Bitter, a quiet grey line of details below, and one row of soft chips above for narrowing the list. Chrome is small, precise and recessive so the photos do the talking.

The system is dark only (`color-scheme: dark`), tonal rather than lined, and strictly tokenised: every colour comes from the `:root` set in `src/index.css`. One sky-blue accent handles links, focus and the active state of a few controls; selection in chips is white-fill, as on YouTube. Green, pink and two warm status colours each own exactly one job, so colour on screen always means something. Density is media-app density: 36px chips, 40px icon buttons, tight caption lines, generous photo area.

It is minimal and uncluttered by owner direction: no decoration that does not carry information, one badge per card at most, and labels in plain Title Case words. The owner has rejected coloured sex icons and a "Photo Needed" badge; both are recorded as Don'ts below.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground (#121212) with three surface steps; depth by tone, shadows only on things that float.
One interactive accent (sky blue); white-fill for chosen chips.
Saira for the wordmark and the game; Bitter for names, place names and panel titles; Hanken Grotesk for every piece of chrome.
5:4 photo frame everywhere a monkey appears, with the name on a dark fade at the photo's foot.
Phone-first: sticky blurred top bar, one toolbar row, two-up grid, 60px bottom bar; computers get a 72px YouTube-style rail that the top bar ☰ opens out.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a `var(--…)` from `:root` in `src/index.css`; a raw hex in a component stylesheet is a defect, not a choice.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Blue is interaction, green is go, pink is destroy-or-cancel in a pop-up, orange is New Arrival, amber is In Sickbay. A colour borrowed for a second job stops meaning either.

rules.name: The White Chip Rule
rules.body: A chosen chip, pill or view button turns Paper White with Page Black text. Blue is never the selected fill.

rules.name: The Name Voice Rule
rules.body: Bitter is reserved for monkey and place names and panel titles; Saira for the wordmark and the game. Buttons, chips, details and labels are always Hanken Grotesk.

rules.name: The Title Case Rule
rules.body: Every button label is Title Case ("Clear All", "Add Photos", "Show More"). Places are written in full on screen ("Dino & Daniel", "Holt & Barrington"); the short forms ("D&D", "H&B") appear only on cards and rows, and a long place name breaks after the "&".

rules.name: The One Row Rule
rules.body: The toolbar stays on a single line at every width down to 320px; controls shrink to icons before anything wraps or scrolls.

rules.name: The Same Size Rule
rules.body: Controls keep their height as the screen narrows (36px chips, 40px icon buttons, 32px chosen-filter chips); only padding and gaps tighten.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface at rest in the page flow has no shadow. If it doesn't sit over other content, it doesn't cast.

rules.name: The 5:4 Frame Rule
rules.body: A monkey photo is always shown in a 5:4 frame, whatever its source shape, so the grid can never be upset by one odd photo.

dos: Do take every colour from the `:root` tokens in `src/index.css`.
Do keep the card details line in the order troop · sex · age, all in Caption Grey (#aaaaaa).
Do show at most one badge per card: New Arrival over In Sickbay.
Do use white-fill (Paper White, Page Black text) for chosen chips, pills and view buttons.
Do write button labels in Title Case and places in full on screen ("Dino & Daniel"); short forms only on cards and rows.
Do keep controls at 36px (chips) and 40px (icon buttons) at every width, extending tap areas to 44px.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: every slide, scale and fade has a no-motion fallback.
Do show a monkey photo in the 5:4 frame with the name on the photo's dark fade.
donts: Don't put a raw hex in a component stylesheet.
Don't colour the sex icons; ♂ and ♀ inherit the grey of the details line.
Don't add a "Photo Needed" badge; a no-photo tile shows only a quiet photo icon.
Don't stack badges on a card or add decoration that carries no information.
Don't use blue as a selected fill, or green, pink, orange or amber for anything outside their one job.
Don't set buttons, chips or details in Bitter.
Don't add shadows to surfaces at rest in the page flow.
Don't let the toolbar wrap onto a second line.
